1. (Currently amended) An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source attached to said handpiece so as to direct at least visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe, __wherein said light source is removably attached to said handpiece via a fastener__.

2. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1, further comprising a power supply mounted at least indirectly to said handpiece and operatively connected to said light source.

3. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2 wherein said power supply includes a coil disposed about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator.

4. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 3 wherein said power supply further includes a slow-drain capacitor for providing energy or power to said light source for a predetermined period of time after termination of power conduction through said cable.

5. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2, further comprising a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece.

6. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 5, further comprising at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece.

7. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2 wherein said power supply is a battery.

8. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source includes a light-emitting diode.

9. (Previously presented) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber extending from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece.

10. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a distal end of said handpiece and is oriented to provide illumination along said probe to the surgical site, __wherein said fastener comprises a clip__.

11. (Previously presented) An accessory for a surgical instrument comprising a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece, and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source.

12. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil disposable about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, further comprising an additional fastener for removably attaching said __power supply component including said__ coil about the power cable.

13. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 12 wherein said power supply component further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil and connectable to said light source for providing illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.

14. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a battery.

15. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said light source includes a light-emitting diode.

16. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber and at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said optical fiber to said handpiece so that said optical fiber extends from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece.

17. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a distal end of said handpiece and for orienting said light source to provide illumination along said probe to a surgical site.

18. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is taken from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band.

19. (Currently amended) A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directable __substantially__ parallel to said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.

20. (Previously presented) The surgical method defined in claim 19 further comprising removably mounting said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece.

21. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil, the removable mounting of said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece including disposing said coil about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator __with an additional fastener for removably attaching said power supply including said coil about the power cable__.

22. (Previously presented) The surgical method defined in claim 21 wherein said power supply further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil, further comprising operating said capacitor to provide illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.

23. (Previously presented) The surgical method defined in claim 19, further comprising removing said fastener and said light source from said handpiece after completion of an operation on said surgical site.

24. (Previously presented) The surgical method defined in claim 19 wherein the applying of said fastener includes positioning said light source at a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising attaching an optical fiber to said handpiece so that said fiber extends from said light source at said proximal end of said handpiece to a distal end of said handpiece.

25. (Currently amended) An accessory for a medical instrument comprising a handpiece and a probe or tool extension on a distal end of said handpiece, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said instrument; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, said power supply component including a coil disposable about a power cable extending to said handpiece, further comprising an additional fastener for removably attaching said __power supply component including said__ coil about the power cable.

26. (Previously presented) The accessory defined in claim 25 wherein said power supply component further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil and connectable to said light source for providing illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.
